doc: Haluna's villagers alive (M3-CRE-613; docs/kb/tech/field_npc.md, VillagerLayer). Each row turns the zone's stand-in at `stand_in` (a path from the zone root) into the M2-CHR-03 villager `npc_id` driven by FieldNpc: `hide` lists the stand-in's placeholder children to hide (default StandIn and Facing), `talk` is the Interactable that starts the villager's talk, `follow` lists nodes that ride along when it walks (the stand-in body always does). Routines: `route` (zone-root points, or {at, pause_sec, activity}), `chat_with` (another row's npc_id), `work_at` (where the head looks while it works; default npc.json work.look_at), `shelter` ([x, y, z, yaw_deg] it hurries to in a storm; Haluna has no storm in the slice). Ground heights were probed against the zone's collision (2026-10-25). The Town's shopkeeper, smith and innkeeper keep their stand-ins until they have bodies (request M3-CRE-614). Since big11, HalunaVillagers (slice-polish, M2-FP-102) places Haluna's villagers inside their bodies in HalunaZone.prebuild(); HalunaZone then calls VillagerLayer.wire(self, &"ch02/haluna"), which adopts them and wires the chat pair, work and shelter points from these rows. The `route` rows (Reed, the child) apply only when the layer places those villagers itself (docs/kb/tech/field_npc.md, Who owns what). The shop rows (`actor`: another villager's model) sit inside their bodies (`attach: child`) as a FieldNpc named by `node_name` `Villager`, where HalunaVillagers.populate looks, so the layer builds at once in the zone's _ready and populate skips those bodies instead of doubling them (big14 gate).

villagers._note: The market stall: setting out wares, looking up at passers-by.
Sweeping the chapel court: two sweep stations, a slow walk between. The court is flat at 2.70.
On the dock: mending, and chatting with the fisher in bouts. The dock's one talk spot turns both of them to the player.
Wandering the tide-wall lane, quick looks about. The lane runs level along x here (2.16 to 2.21).
By her house with the bag at her feet: she watches the lane and the party.
The elder with her bowl (the stand-in's bowl hides: the body carries no prop yet, M3-CRE-614).
M3-CRE-100: the shopkeeper wore the netmender's model until M3-CHR-512 built their own (the Lead, 2026-10-30: named interactable villagers wear their bespoke models).
M3-CRE-100: the smith wore the fisher's model until M3-CHR-512 built their own (the Lead, 2026-10-30: named interactable villagers wear their bespoke models).
M3-CRE-100: the innkeeper wore the vendor's model until M3-CHR-512 built their own (the Lead, 2026-10-30: named interactable villagers wear their bespoke models).
